Description:
As a member, I want to enroll my loan in auto-pay from online banking, so that I never miss a payment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Member selects a loan and a funding account
- Member picks the payment day of month
- Enrollment is saved and a confirmation screen is shown

As a member, I want my fixed auto-pay amount validated, so that my payment always covers the minimum due.

Acceptance Criteria:
- If the fixed amount is below the minimum due, the enrollment is rejected

As a member, I want to cancel my auto-pay enrollment, so that I control my payments.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Member can cancel an active enrollment from online banking
- A cancelled enrollment makes no further payments
